items.title: 12.12 Drugs, dyes aur fragrances ki organic synthesis mein sulfur ka kirdar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.12, printed page 283.

blocks.text: Carbon-sulfur bonds hayatiyati, dawai aur maadi khusoosiyat wale compounds ki wasee range mein milte hain. Yeh thiols ya mercaptans (R-SH), thioethers (R-S-R), sulfoxides (R-S(=O)-R) aur sulfones (R-SO2-R) jaise functional groups wale bohat se organic compounds banate hain. Agle teen topics drugs, dyes aur odorants mein misalein dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Disulfide pulon (bridges) ki kya ahmiyat hai (exercise Q.2m)?
blocks.explanation: Disulfide pul, S-S, do thiol groups ke oxidise hone par banta hai; proteins mein yeh zanjeeron ke andar ya darmiyan cysteine units ko jorta aur mura hua dhancha sambhalta hai, jaise sulfur cross-links vulcanised rubber ko sambhalte hain. Aise pul enzymes, antibodies aur baalon ke keratin ko mustahkam karte hain.

items: C-S bonds thiols (R-SH), thioethers, sulfoxides, sulfones dete hain; drugs, dyes aur fragrances mein istemal.
